verdict.rationale: Poke's release notes say it can create tables and charts from described data or from images of spreadsheets, which covers the chart-output part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the assistant writing or running code, computing answers through execution, or producing downloadable files. Missing for 10: documented code execution on user data, computed analysis results, downloadable file outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files

citations.quote: Poke can now create tables and charts to help you visualize data. Describe what you want to see, or share images of existing data (like spreadsheets) for Poke to extract and visualize.
